title: Use the half-open a-file
summary: After the queen trade, support the c4 pawn and use the rook's pressure on a2.

fromNode.nodeId: d4 d5 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 Qb6 Qb3 c4 Qxb6 axb6 Nd2 Nf6

goal: Keep pressure on a2 while developing and supporting the c4 pawn.

steps.text: In the example, the a-pawn retakes on b6 after the queen trade. The rook has a half-open a-file and attacks a2.
In the example, the white rook on a1 defends a2. Do not take the pawn while that rook can recapture.
In the example, the pawn on b6 can go to b5. There it defends c4 and gains queenside space.

steps.text: In the example, develop the c8 bishop before closing its diagonal with the e-pawn. Keep checking the a-file as the pieces move.

jobs.text: The rook attacks the defended a2 pawn along the half-open file.
The pawn controls b3 and d3.
The bishop can develop along its open diagonal.

breaks.text: The pawn can advance to defend c4.

opponent.text: White can move the a-pawn or add defenders. Recheck the file before trying to win a pawn.

notNow: Do not take on a2 while the rook on a1 can recapture.

mistakes.text: The a2 pawn is defended by the rook on a1. Develop or support c4 instead of taking it.

comments.text: The bishop develops before the e-pawn moves.
